notes: Bring-up chain: read the board datasheet, translate hex register/load/entry facts into a correct JSON machine profile for a generic profile-driven emulator host, wire an executable runner with a three-mode CLI that drives the installed emulator (not a reimplementation), then run the legacy image and capture its serial output. The verifier re-executes the runner on the shipped image and on hidden images probing wrap-around arithmetic, unknown opcodes, truncated records, missing HLT, and empty output. Rubric nonzero for dependent_stages (profile -> runner -> captured output), tool_breadth (emulator host + bash + JSON), reasoning_depth (datasheet translation, edge-case semantics), debugging_ambiguity (wrong profile yields wrong/empty output), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (hidden images), and quantitative_correctness (byte-exact arithmetic output). No resource pressure; totals bucket to hard via the multi-stage bring-up and setup breadth.
